name: Katana
description: Your gun becomes a sword that slashes bullets out of the air.
details: Your gun becomes a samurai sword. Click to slash everything in front of you (140% of your bullet damage, with all your bullet effects); a slash also cuts enemy bullets out of the air, so they never hit, explode or burn. Hold to charge a flying slash wave that carries all your bullet cards and cuts bullets in its path. More fire rate = faster swings and faster charging. No ammo, no reload.
